'''Dedication Day''' was a celebration that took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] in [[4975 BBY]], twenty-five years after the arrival of [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] on the planet. The gathering took place in the [[Circle Eternal]] plaza in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tahv]].
